MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader fit my repeated purchases of removable storage and file-transfer accessories. More capacity would be useful if the card works with my devices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a practical new use for my television: streaming. That appeals to me even though my listed 720p TV would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, displays, and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but my purchases do not establish that need.",
    "Desktop memory does not serve the same purpose as my memory cards, and a home-monitoring camera does not address the photography needs behind my tripods and lens cap.",
    "The USB-C cables could be useful, but my history includes Micro USB, Mini USB, and 30-pin cables. I would need to confirm USB-C compatibility before choosing them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although I chose accessories with specific uses.",
    "Broad connections such as electronics, cameras, storage, and car accessories seem to matter too much when the recommended products solve different problems from my purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy items that support equipment I already use, such as mounts, cables, memory cards, readers, and protective storage cases. Whether an item fits that equipment matters to me.",
    "The purpose of an accessory matters: my GPS mounts help position a device, and my power strips provide connections and protection. Neither establishes a need for Alexa or remote control."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my practical storage and television needs, but stretched my electronics purchases into an unsupported interest in smart-home devices."
}
